events.event: Bank Indonesia cut the average bank reserve requirement (GWM) by 2 percentage points alongside holding the BI-Rate and extending the LTV/FTV property-loan policy, while the rupiah still weakened.
events.key_numbers: GWM conventional banks 9% to 7% · sharia banks and units 7.5% to 5.5% · rupiah closed Rp18,060/USD on 22 Oct, down 38 points (0.21%) from Rp18,022 · SBN yields 5Y 7.21%, 10Y 7.43%, 15Y 7.42%, 20Y 7.41% · bond volume Rp24.39 T
events.why_it_matters: Looser reserve rules free up bank cash for loans, yet the rupiah kept sliding past Rp18,000, showing the pressure is from outside money flows.

events.event: The rupiah closed Friday 23 October at Rp18,067 per USD, 0.01% weaker, and analysts see it testing Rp18,200 next week with oil prices as the main risk.
events.key_numbers: Rupiah Rp18,067/USD (-0.01%) on 23 Oct · forecast Rp18,200 for week of 26 Oct (Bisnis headline) · IHSG 5,439.26 on 23 Oct
events.why_it_matters: A rupiah above Rp18,000 makes imports, fuel and dollar debt costlier for ordinary people and companies.

events.event: Phintraco Sekuritas expects the IHSG to test 5,500-5,600 in the week starting 26 October after a 4.90% weekly gain, with 5,400 as the key level and oil prices and the rupiah as risks.
events.key_numbers: IHSG 5,439.26 on 23 Oct (+0.95%) · weekly +4.90% · target 5,500-5,600 · support 5,400 · all sectors up on Friday · daily value Rp13.85 T on 23 Oct
events.why_it_matters: Shows whether the market rebound from the MSCI-driven slump to a pandemic-era low has legs before HSC stocks drop out of the index on 2 November.

events.event: BEI said the MSCI proposal to move Indonesia from Emerging to Standalone is only a consultation, not a final decision, and that it will ask MSCI to clarify the basis for the announcement.
events.key_numbers: Consultation runs to 30 Apr 2027 · MSCI announced 15 Oct 2026 · HSC stocks excluded from IHSG from 2 Nov 2026
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia's market status, and billions of dollars of passive foreign money, hinge on a decision still months away.
